subject: ACME - POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -0000
Subject: ACME - POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps

Hi Sarah --

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed plan for the 4-week POC your team requested. Goal here is to validate latency and cost improvements for your customer support summarization pipeline while maintaining answer accuracy (ROUGE/F1 targets).

Pain points you called out:
- High per-token inference cost at peak times (esp. night shift)
- Latency spikes on long conversations (>2k tokens) causing timeouts in your UI
- Lack of deterministic rollout and no automated fallbacks when capacity is constrained

POC objective and success metrics:
- Primary objective: Reduce per-conversation inference cost by >=30% while keeping summary accuracy within -3% of current baseline (based on your annotated prompt set)
- Latency SLO: p95 < 800ms for typical 1k-token requests; p95 < 1.5s for 2k tokens
- Acceptance: Internal evals (prompt-set) + two weeks of live comparison traffic at 20% sample rate

Scope & plan (4 weeks):
Week 0 (access/setup): API keys, VPC peering (if needed), sample dataset + baseline prompts
Week 1 (integration): Runbook + integration with your staging environment; seeding prefix cache
Week 2 (tuning): Quantization/profile tuning, batching, prompt engineering + evals
Week 3 (validation): Live A/B at 20% for 2 weeks -- rollout and metrics collection

Owners:
- Redwood: Aditya Rao (account lead), Rishi Malhotra (solutions/SE), Marissa Cole (CS lead)
- Acme: Sarah Lowe (eng lead), Procurement (procurement@acme.com)

Prompt set & evals: We will use the prompt_set_v1 (attached) plus your annotated labels to compute accuracy deltas. SE will run automated regression checks and surface any quality drift.

Access / setup required from Acme:
1) Create a staging API key for redwood-poc (scoped to staging) and share via your vault or our secure upload
2) Provide a one-hour walkthrough of your staging environment for the SE team (Rishi)
3) Share a representative sample of 200 conversation transcripts (PII redacted)

Attachments: redwood-poc-scope.pdf (POC scope & runbook) -- see attached.

Next actions / proposed dates:
- Kickoff call: propose Mon, Oct 18 at 16:00 ET (I'll send invite once we confirm)
- Procurement: Sarah to loop in procurement for the standard POC MSA/SOW and access approvals

If that all sounds right, I'll lock the kickoff for Oct 18 and share the detailed poc-plan.xlsx and evaluation-prompt-set.txt.

Thanks -- looking forward to working together.

--
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sarah Lowe <sarah.lowe@acme.com>

Cc: Acme Corp Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:10:00 -0000
Subject: Re: ACME - POC Kickoff Recap & Next Steps

Hi Aditya --

Thanks for the detailed recap -- this matches our notes. A few clarifications:
- The team can provision the staging API key today; I will ask our security team to share it via our vault and let you know once it's uploaded.
- We can provide 200 redacted transcripts; target to deliver by Friday
- Procurement asked if the POC can proceed under our standard POC SOW (we prefer not to sign a full MSA immediately). Is that acceptable?

The proposed kickoff time (Oct 18 at 16:00 ET) works for our engineers. Can you confirm the estimated peak GPU footprint for the POC so we can ensure network/firewall rules are in place?

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lowe
Director of Engineering, Acme Corp
sarah.lowe@acme.com

Rishi -- can you draft the infra/runbook checklist for firewall rules and estimated GPU footprint? Sarah asked about peak GPU footprint for the POC; ballpark we should state: 1 x A100-equivalent for validation day and autoscaled instances during live A/B (burst to 2 nodes) -- please confirm.
Marissa -- once we have the key and the transcripts, can your CS team own the 20% live A/B rollout and metric dashboarding? We'll need a 1-hr training with Acme on the dashboard.
I'll confirm the kickoff invite after procurement confirms the SOW route.
--Aditya
